data.narrative:
Path Power operates in the Climate & Energy sector at an undisclosed stage. The comparable universe consists of one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. This modest peer set reflects the nascent, heterogeneous nature of frontier climate technology.

The peer-median valuation method is not applicable to this analysis. Despite identifying eight same-sector peers, the narrow filter criteria—same stage, adjacent stage, and similar valuation tier—yielded fewer than three datapoints required for reliable triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce excessive noise and obscure meaningful valuation signals specific to Path Power's position within Climate & Energy. The methodological constraint is binding: insufficient granular comparables at the required specificity level.

Given these limitations, a defensible valuation cannot be derived from the available data and stated methodology. Proceeding would require either widening filter criteria (risking apples-to-oranges comparisons), obtaining additional private market transaction data, or deploying alternative methods such as discounted cash flow analysis with disclosed financial projections—none of which are present here. Further diligence on Path Power's stage classification, recent funding terms, and revenue or runway metrics would be necessary to enable triangulation-based valuation.
